title: Authorize v0.5.70 provider publication from clean main
rawUserRequest: 开WI修正，然后清理远程和本地，确认没有问题了，最后发布新版本。

declaredIntent.summary: Publish exactly v0.5.70 from the latest verified default-branch source through the authoritative same-SHA rehearsal and release workflow, then complete evidence-bound human closeout.

authorityEvidence.scope: Publish exactly v0.5.70 after completing all release readiness, same-SHA rehearsal, Hosted, Provider, tagged Quick Install, and post-publication gates; no bypass or historical tag mutation is authorized.

outOfScope: Changing release workflow security controls, installer behavior, SBOM/provenance generators, signing infrastructure, or branch protection.
Modifying, deleting, moving, reusing, or republishing the immutable v0.5.69 tag or Provider Release.
Publishing any tag or Release other than v0.5.70.
Bypassing a failed readiness, rehearsal, Hosted CI, supply-chain, Draft asset, tagged Quick Install, or post-publication gate.
Rewriting historical Work Item archives or deleting unrelated user-owned worktrees and dirty files.

riskAssessment.reason: Publication creates an immutable public tag and Provider assets. Source, tag, metadata, archive, installer, SBOM, provenance, CI evidence, Draft validation, and public Quick Install must remain mutually bound.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: The v0.5.70 candidate, latest merged main, requested tag, and Provider source identity disagree.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Readiness or release preflight fails closed before tag creation and no public release is claimed.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run check-release-readiness, resolve exact origin/main, require candidate v0.5.70, and bind the release workflow to the same source SHA.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Same-SHA smoke, compatibility, lockfile, SBOM, provenance, or release evidence is absent, stale, or failed.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Publication remains stopped before immutable tag mutation.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Dispatch a release rehearsal for the exact source SHA, verify the successful receipt, and require the release workflow to validate all exact-SHA evidence.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Provider Draft assets, immutable tag metadata, archive, installer, or tagged Quick Install disagree.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The workflow leaves the Release unpublished or fails closed; v0.5.70 is not reported as stable until public verification passes.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Use the release workflow's Draft asset and tagged Quick Install gates, then run check-release-distribution-post-publish against the public tag and assets.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: The final human report omits status, implementation approach, evidence, residual risk, or lifecycle cleanup facts.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Outcome remains incomplete/yellow and the Work Item cannot close until a standalone conversation-visible report is complete.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run strict ai-finish, inspect the generated human report, emit a separate full Outcome in this dialogue, then archive and close only after PR and branch cleanup.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Publication cleanup reaches the historical v0.5.69 identity or unrelated dirty worktrees.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Only this Work Item's identity is changed; v0.5.69 and unrelated user-owned state remain untouched.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Audit tags, Provider Releases, worktrees, local status, and closure receipt after publication.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: The public v0.5.70 Release is valid but local release metadata and installer defaults still point at an older version.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The canonical synchronizer promotes v0.5.70 as the stable projection and advances only the next unpublished candidate to v0.5.71.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run sync_published_release_projection.py with the independently downloaded public release.json and release-digests.json, then run release state, distribution, source-bound, and status consistency checks.

acceptance: The Contract records explicit user authority for one v0.5.70 public publication and forbids gate bypasses or historical tag mutation.
Synchronized main passes release readiness and source-bound preflight for the exact candidate before Provider dispatch.
A successful same-SHA release rehearsal is recorded and the release workflow verifies the same source, tag, archive, installer, CI, SBOM, provenance, and digest identity.
The Provider workflow completes Draft asset validation, immutable tag validation, tagged Quick Install, and public post-publication verification before v0.5.70 is reported as published.

The verified public v0.5.70 assets are synchronized into the repository's stable release projection, installer default, canonical release state, and next unpublished v0.5.71 candidate without mutating the immutable Provider tag.
The Work Item produces a standalone, complete, human-facing Outcome in the conversation with traffic-light status, implementation approach, evidence, residual risk, and next action.
The Work Item completes the canonical archive, PR, merge, ai-close-work-item, local/remote branch cleanup, and synchronized main checks without changing v0.5.69 or unrelated user-owned state.
guidelines: Preserve the distinction between candidate, immutable tag, Draft/stable Provider Release, and public distribution evidence.
Use only the controlled release workflow for external Provider mutation.
Do not retry a failing release path until the exact failing gate is diagnosed and recorded.
Never claim v0.5.70 publication or public installation success before Provider-bound evidence verifies it.
Keep the final Outcome as a standalone human-facing report in the conversation, not a raw evidence-file dump.

intent.problem: The v0.5.69 Provider Release is stable and the repository has prepared the next unpublished v0.5.70 candidate. The remaining objective is one evidence-bound v0.5.70 Provider publication from the latest merged main.
constraints: Use only the exact latest origin/main source and the v0.5.70 candidate identity.
Do not mutate v0.5.69 or any historical tag, Release, archive, or unrelated worktree.
Do not create an immutable tag or public asset until all release and Hosted gates pass.
Keep the final Outcome standalone, complete, human-facing, and visible in this conversation.
intent.rationale: A dedicated publication Work Item separates the irreversible Provider action from the completed corrective Work Item and preserves source identity, approval, and post-publication evidence.

verification.reason: The release workflow and exact-SHA Hosted rehearsal are the authoritative publication quality gates; redundant local full quality is not substituted for them.

rollbackNote: Before Provider mutation, discard only this Work Item branch. After immutable tag creation, never move or delete the tag; quarantine an invalid Draft Release and create a corrective Work Item for the next patch.
